text:
alex_chan: Quick experiment update — ran weight-only INT8 (bitsandbytes/llm.int8) on mistral-7b with our standard prompt suite. Results below.

priya: nice — numbers?

alex_chan: baseline fp16 p50 latency ~72ms/token, throughput ~120 tok/s on g5.16xlarge. int8 weight-only p50 ~52ms/token, throughput ~165 tok/s. ~28% latency reduction, +37% throughput.

sam_k: what's the quality hit? perplexity / EM / F1?

alex_chan: on our redwood-v1 eval set (alignment + code + QA): EM drop ~0.7 pts, F1 drop ~0.9 pts, PPL up ~1.8%. Instruction-following probes: minor divergence in a few edge cases (math formatting, some multi-step code).

marie_olsen: did you use per-channel scaling (llm.int8) or legacy bnb 8-bit? any activation quant?

alex_chan: used llm.int8 weight-only (per-channel) via bitsandbytes. No activation quant, no LoRA quant. Commands I ran: 

```
python -m torchrun --nnodes=1 --nproc_per_node=8 serve.py \\n  --model mistral-7b --quantize llm.int8 --bitsandbytes 8
```

and the eval harness: 

```
python eval.py --suite redwood-v1 --batch 8 --max_tokens 512
```

priya: OK. compared against GPTQ / AWQ?

alex_chan: quick bakeoff notes: 
- GPTQ (4-bit): best quality in many slices, but long compile time and big CPU memory usage; runtime slower on our infra due to dequant overhead.
- AWQ (hybrid 4/8): quality close to GPTQ, faster than GPTQ in several configs, needs custom kernel/patches.
- llm.int8 weight-only: best throughput and simplest integration; smallest infra changes. Quality slightly worse than GPTQ/AWQ on edge-case math/code.

sam_k: Any regression alerts triggered?

alex_chan: Ran the regression suite — a few prompt slices exceeded our threshold (delta EM > 2.0) and were flagged. Uploaded diffs to the eval dashboard: https://console.redwood/models/mistral-7b/quant-bakeoff

marie_olsen: For deployment, can we do policy-based routing? e.g., int8 for low-cost, fp16 fallback when confidence low?

alex_chan: Yup — proposed rollout: 
- 60% traffic -> int8 weight-only (default low-cost)
- 30% traffic -> fp16 (high-quality fallback)
- 10% traffic -> canary AWQ for targeted customers

Route rule example (pseudo): 
```
if eval_confidence < 0.85: route -> fp16
else: route -> int8
```

sam_k: memory / OOM notes?

alex_chan: int8 reduced host GPU memory by ~18GB on a 32GB A100, allowed 2 extra concurrent workers per node. But LoRA/adapter fine-tuning still requires fp16/float32 for optimizer states.

priya: action items?

alex_chan: 1) Triage the ~2% EM regressions (assigned to @sam_k). 2) Run 24h stability load with int8 serving + KV caching on @marie_olsen infra. 3) Add dashboard panel: EM delta by customer + prompt slice. 4) Proposal: default hosted "starter" tier = int8 weight-only; will open PR with scripts.

ci-bot: deploy job queued: quant-bake-1718200000 (logs: /ci/1718200000) :white_check_mark:

sam_k: I'll take triage. Thanks.
